entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Get me a person, now! This is ridiculous!
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, 'Alex', you can help me by taking back this piece of junk you sent me. I want a refund and I want it now. This whole experience has been a disaster.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your order. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item you received?
The issue? The issue is that your company can't get a simple order right! It's the jersey I bought. The size is completely wrong. It's so tight I can barely breathe! This is not what I paid for.
I understand your frustration with the fit, and I apologize for the inconvenience. So the jersey is the wrong size, it's just too tight for you. Is that correct?

Are you listening to me?! Yes, it's the wrong size! I'm not going to say it again. Are you going to fix this or do I need to speak to your manager? I swear, I have a one-star review ready to post on every website I can find.
There's no need for that, I can absolutely handle this for you. I just need to pull up your order to get the process started. Do you have the order number handy?
Fine. It's VF8-675-309. You'd better not give me the runaround on this.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Apex Racing jersey, delivered five days ago. You are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window, so we have a couple of options. We can cannot offer a refund, or I can help you with an exchange for a larger size right now.
An exchange? How long is that going to take? I'm not waiting another two weeks.

Not at all. I can process the exchange immediately. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label to send back the jersey that's too tight. As soon as the carrier scans that package, we'll ship out the new size to you with our standard 3-5 business day shipping.
So I get a free shipping label? And the new one ships as soon as I send the old one back?
That's correct. There is no cost to you for the exchange.
Okay... fine. That's acceptable. Send me the next size up. And make sure it's right this time.
Excellent. I have just submitted the exchange order for you. The email with the return label is on its way to your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Just don't mess it up.
We'll take care of it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
